decisions.reason: The same-message MODIFY already records the Small Block pool target, trigger, and secondary-royalty contribution; no additional change is required.
The same-message MODIFY already records the independent counters, issuance rules, eligibility windows, reset actions, and exclusion of secondary-sale tickets.
The same-message INTRODUCE already records that secondary royalties fund both prize pools without creating referral tickets.
The same-message MODIFY already records the Big Block and Small Block ticket eligibility windows relevant to winner selection.
The source explicitly says manual claim remains identical, so the collection requirement remains valid unchanged.
The same-message INTRODUCE already records display of both ticket counters and permanent badges; the Big Block pool target does not require another metadata-state change.
The source states that the random ticket allocation when no referral is used remains identical, so this requirement is unchanged.
